info.title: AnatoVision API
info.description: See docs/api_contract.md. Errors are always {"error": string}.

post.description: Wrong login -> 401. Throttled: 5 failures for one username, or LOGIN_IP_MAX (20) failures from one address, in 5 minutes -> 429.

get.description: What this student may use. An instructor sees everything granted (or, while previewing, the previewed student's grants).
Newest first. Empty chats (no question yet) are left out of the history.

schema.title: Response List Chats Api Chats Get

post.description: A new, empty chat titled "New chat". If the user already has an empty chat it is returned instead of making another one.

get.description:
Where a question is: searching | reading | writing | checking | done. Send POST /api/ask with a `request_id`, then poll this once a second.
Only the stage word is returned. The answer itself arrives whole in the POST response, after the student-safe layer has run. 404 until the
POST has registered the id (treat it as "searching"), and for another user's id.

post.description: A student's "Report an error": goes to the instructor's queue (data/flags.jsonl, type student_report). A preview saves nothing.

schema.title: Response List Guides Api Guides Get
Response Guide Stations Api Guides  Guide Id  Stations Get

get.description: The WHOLE slide (with its step text): instructors only, for "View original slide" in the editor. A student gets 403 even for a guide they may open.

post.description: "Explain simply": a short AI explanation under the station's steps, from the guide and the lecture notes the student may open only. Labelled as AI.

get.description:
A short note for this station and the cadaver's body type: a line grounded in the slide text when it mentions fat, fascia, muscle or depth,
and up to two lines labelled "General tip, not from your notes". Empty for a picture-only station or a body type with nothing to adapt to.

schema.title: Response Lecture Stations Api Lectures  Lecture Id  Stations Get
Response Guide History Api Guide History Get

put.description: Called when a student opens a station. A preview saves nothing. The guide or lecture must be open to the student.

delete.description: Remove one of the student's own history items. Someone else's item is a 404.

schema.title: Response Latest Api Quiz Latest Get
Response History Api Quiz History Get

delete.description: Remove one finished quiz from the student's own history. Another student's quiz is a 404, never a 403.

post.description:
verify = Dr. Inglis confirms the line is wrong (or rewords it) and gives the corrected text, which students then see in its place.
dismiss = the notes are correct as written. Both go through review.decide -> verified.resolve, like the dashboard. A student report
can only be dismissed (marked handled).

get.description: Every student quiz with at least one question built from Wikipedia (never a preview quiz), newest first.

schema.title: Response Students Api Admin Students Get

post.description:
profile: "full" (a student who may use every lecture) or a student's id. Until /preview/exit, the student tools act as that student
and nothing is saved as theirs.

schema.title: Response Versions Api Admin Notes  Doc Id  Versions Get
Response Audit Api Admin Notes  Doc Id  Audit Get

post.description: The instructor looked at the question again after the notes changed: refresh its links and clear the mark.
The instructor looked at a cropped picture. A low-confidence crop reaches students only after this.
